title: Lithospermic acid targeting heat shock protein 90 attenuates LPS-induced inflammatory response via NF-small ka, CyrillicB signalling pathway in BV2 microglial cells.
authors: Guo, Jie; Li, Chen-Guang; Mai, Feng-Yi; Liang, Jing-Rong; Chen, Ze-Hao; Luo, Jiao; Zhou, Ming-Chao; Wang, Yu-Long; Yang, Wen-Tao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究紫草酸通过靶向HSP90抑制NF-κB通路减轻小胶质细胞炎症，虽含分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Microglia function as a vital constituent in the maintenance of brain homeostasis. Aberrant microglial activation, however, may contribute to neurodegenerative diseases. Lithospermic acid (LA) is a plant-derived polycyclic phenolic carboxylic acid isolated from Salvia miltiorrhiza. The present study investigated the potential effects of lithospermic acid on LPS-induced neuroinflammation in BV2 microglial cells and determined the mechanism of action of this compound. Cells were pre-treated with lithospermic acid for 1 h and incubated with LPS for 24 h. qPCR, immunofluorescence, and immunoblot assays were used to determine the expression of iNOS, COX2, NF-kappaB p65, and HSP90 expression. ELISA was employed to measure the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines. Lithospermic acid dramatically reduced LPS-stimulated cell migration and decreased NF-kappaB p65 nuclear translocation. Furthermore, lithospermic acid also markedly decreased the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including IL-6, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha in a dose-dependent manner. Additionally, lithospermic acid inhibited NO and PGE2 production in response to LPS, and it also inhibited the expression of iNOS and COX2 in a dose-dependent manner. Molecular docking and experimental verification have demonstrated that lithospermic acid inhibits the activity and expression of HSP90. Small interfering RNA knockdown of HSP90 expression, which abrogated LPS-induced inflammation. These findings suggest that the lithospermic acid targeting HSP90 attenuates LPS-induced inflammatory response via the NF-kappaB signalling pathway in BV2 microglial cells. Collectively, lithospermic acid may offer therapeutic benefits for neurodegenerative disorders associated with microglial activation and could serve as a potential inhibitor/agent for the treatment of neuroinflammation.
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞在维持大脑稳态中发挥着至关重要的组成作用。然而，异常的小胶质细胞激活可能促进神经退行性疾病的发生。紫草酸 (lithospermic acid, LA) 是一种从丹参 (Salvia miltiorrhiza) 中分离得到的植物来源多环酚羧酸。本研究探讨了紫草酸对脂多糖 (LPS) 诱导的BV2小胶质细胞神经炎症的潜在影响，并确定了该化合物的作用机制。细胞先用紫草酸预处理1小时，再与LPS共孵育24小时。采用qPCR、免疫荧光和免疫印迹实验检测iNOS、COX2、NF-kappaB p65和HSP90的表达水平。使用ELISA法测量促炎细胞因子的产生。紫草酸显著降低了LPS刺激的细胞迁移，并减少了NF-kappaB p65的核转位。此外，紫草酸还以剂量依赖性方式显著降低了促炎细胞因子（包括IL-6、IL-1beta和TNF-alpha）的产生。同时，紫草酸抑制了LPS诱导的NO和PGE2产生，并以剂量依赖性方式抑制了iNOS和COX2的表达。分子对接和实验验证表明，紫草酸抑制HSP90的活性和表达。小干扰RNA敲低HSP90表达可消除LPS诱导的炎症。这些发现表明，紫草酸通过靶向HSP90，经NF-kappaB信号通路减弱LPS诱导的BV2小胶质细胞炎症反应。综上，紫草酸可能为与小胶质细胞激活相关的神经退行性疾病提供治疗益处，并可作为治疗神经炎症的潜在抑制剂/药物。
